name: the device's sync state (base, journal, logs, all of which name every file) is readable by its owner only
description: JOTTA-025 (Jottacloud): jottad listened on 0.0.0.0 and its config and data folders had wrong permissions. AzDrive has no network control socket (its debug server exists only under AZ_DEBUG/AZ_E2E); the part that applies is rule S19 (the state folder 0700, its files 0600). sync-chaos sec-local-secrets-hygiene.
